title: {channel} viewer queue on Twitch | ItsBagelBot
metaDescription: See who is in line to play with {channel} on Twitch and who gets called next. Join from the Twitch chat with !join. Updated live.
aboutBody: {channel} runs a viewer queue through ItsBagelBot, a free Twitch chat bot. Type !join in the Twitch chat to get in line and !leave to step out. The streamer calls viewers in the order they joined.
aboutLink: Add a viewer queue to your channel
tagline: Who is in line and who gets called next, updated live.
joinHint: Join from chat with !join or !queue join.
boardNote: First in, first called. Shows up to {max} viewers.
emptyBody: When viewers join the queue, they show up here.
noMatchBody: Nobody in the queue matches that name.
degraded: The queue can't load right now. This page keeps trying.
